battle.name: 朝鮮上空
battle.brief: 噴射機與二戰剩餘戰車同時在場。空優沒有自動變成佔領每一座山。只打部隊。F-86與MiG-15在三八線以北的走廊反覆交鋒，炸彈、砲火與飛行員之間的差距，仍然決定地面推進的速度。

kit.name: 軍刀
kit.history: 北美的後掠翼噴射機。交換比常被講成神話，雷達瞄準和飛行員經驗是可以核對的部分。

countries: 交戰方分成天上的兩條線和地下的兩條線。天上是聯合國軍空中力量對上蘇聯與中國的志願航空兵，地下是朝鮮人民軍對上南韓與美軍地面部隊。聯合國軍空中力量由美軍遠東空軍統一指揮，麾下以第8戰鬥機轟炸聯隊（F-80、F-86）、第18戰鬥機聯隊（第39戰鬥攔截中隊、第16戰鬥攔截中隊等）與第51戰鬥機聯隊為主，配屬F-51野馬式近地支援機、T-6夜戰機、RB-26與B-29轟炸機；英國皇家海軍的艦載航空兵以HMS Triumph參戰，澳洲、紐西蘭等國飛行員編入美國聯隊作戰。蘇聯方面以第64戰鬥航空兵為核心，下轄第291、351、469等戰鬥機團，駐安東與大浦，飛行員與技師輪換作戰。中國人民志願軍空軍在一九五一年二月投入戰鬥，第1至第4師及獨立團駐瀋陽、安東、遼陽，裝備蘇聯供應的MiG-15。朝鮮人民空軍在戰役初期只有蘇聯移交的螺旋槳戰鬥機、教練機與少量噴射機，地面部隊多屬二戰剩餘裝備；北韓空軍在1950年底之後已失去制空權，餘下飛機主要用於偵察與夜間騷擾。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict ran along two lines, one in the air and one on the ground. In the air, the United Nations air forces faced the Soviet and Chinese volunteer aviation forces; on the ground, the Korean People's Army faced South Korean and American ground units. United Nations air power was unified under the US Far East Air Forces, whose principal units were the 8th Fighter-Bomber Wing (F-80 and F-86), the 18th Fighter Wing (including the 39th and 16th Fighter-Interceptor Squadrons) and the 51st Fighter Wing, supported by F-51 Mustang ground attack aircraft, T-6 night fighters, and RB-26 and B-29 bombers. The Royal Navy's carrier aviation took part through HMS Triumph, and Australian, New Zealand and other Commonwealth pilots flew inside American wings. On the Soviet side the core was the 64th Fighter Aviation Corps with its 291st, 351st and 469th fighter regiments, based at Antung and Taepyong, with pilots and technicians rotated in and out of combat. The Chinese People's Volunteer Air Force entered the fight in February 1951, its 1st through 4th divisions and independent regiments stationed at Shenyang, Antung and Liaoyang, flying Soviet-supplied MiG-15s. The Korean People's Air Force opened the war with only a small force of Soviet-transferred piston fighters, trainers and a handful of jets, while its ground units were largely equipped with Second World War leftovers; after the end of 1950 it had lost air supremacy, and the aircraft that remained were used mainly for reconnaissance and night harassment.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊，但真正讓這場空戰成形的是蘇聯第64戰鬥航空兵的一批飛行員與工程師，以及後來被冠上「米格走廊」這名字的戰場。蘇聯方面，第64戰鬥航空兵的指揮體系在一九五〇年十一月至十二月的密集交戰中反覆改組，飛行員以四至八機編隊在蘇聯本國、中國志願軍空軍與北韓空軍之間輪換；米格設計局把MiG-15由試驗推到量產只用了約兩年，這在戰後航空工業裡是異常的速度。中國人民志願軍空軍的第一批飛行員在1950年12月21日取得第一個空戰勝利，此後在志願軍空軍作戰期間持續出動，把北方的空戰從蘇聯人手上接了過來。聯合國軍一側，第39戰鬥攔截中隊在1951至1952年間累積取得最多的米格-15宣稱擊落紀錄，第51戰鬥機聯隊自1951年2月到位後接替第18聯隊的主要攔截任務；像James Jabara這樣被戰果記錄正式認定擊落十四架以上米格-15的飛行員，成為這段歷史的代表。指揮層面上，遠東空軍指揮官在1950年11月由Wilkinson交接予Twining，第八航空隊指揮官范弗里負責前線戰鬥航空兵的使用；地面指揮部麥克阿瑟、范弗里與李奇微的戰役目標直接決定空軍要飛哪一條線，而1950年10月的「統一」計畫與沃克島事件，更把中蘇直接介入推到不可收拾的地步。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities stood on both sides, but the people who actually shaped this air war were a handful of Soviet pilots and engineers of the 64th Fighter Aviation Corps, and the stretch of sky that would later be given the name Mig Alley. On the Soviet side the command structure of the 64th Fighter Aviation Corps was reorganised again and again during the intense fighting of November and December 1950, with pilots rotated in four- to eight-aircraft formations between the Soviet Union itself, the Chinese Volunteer Air Force and the North Korean air force; the Mikoyan bureau pushed the MiG-15 from test aircraft into production in about two years, an extraordinary pace for the postwar aircraft industry. The first Chinese volunteer pilots scored their first aerial victory on 21 December 1950 and kept flying through the whole period of the Volunteer Air Force's operations, taking over the northern air battle from Soviet hands. On the United Nations side the 39th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron accumulated the largest number of claimed MiG-15 kills between 1951 and 1952, and the 51st Fighter Wing, which arrived in February 1951, took over the main interception task from the 18th Wing; pilots such as James Jabara, formally credited with more than fourteen MiG-15 victories, became the public face of this history. At command level the Far East Air Forces commander changed hands from Wilkinson to Twining in November 1950, while General Van Fleet, commanding the Eighth Air Force, ran the combat aviation on the front; the operational aims of MacArthur, Van Fleet and Ridgway on the ground decided which axis the air force was ordered to fly, and the October 1950 plan to unify Korea, together with the incidents around Wonsan, pushed direct Chinese and Soviet involvement to the point of no return.
kits: 本卡兵器F-86「佩刀」式戰鬥機是這場空戰的另一主角。1949年量產，後掠翼加機首複數發機槍，六挺M3勃朗寧.50口徑機槍共備彈三百發，J47渦輪發動機，最大平飛速度約每秒三百公尺，實用升限一萬五千公尺左右；機首雷達只作搜索，早期火控靠目視與瞄準具，後期機才加裝雷達瞄準與前後座分置的照相機。對手是同樣在1949年入列的MiG-15：三十五度後掠翼，六門三十七公厘航炮配兩門二十三公厘機炮，爆破殺傷力遠勝.50子彈；爬升率與升限佔優，轉彎半徑卻與F-86同樣笨重。中國志願軍空軍裝備的MiG-15多為改進型，配備可搜索作戰距離十數公里的機載雷達。朝鮮人民空軍則以蘇聯移交的螺旋槳戰鬥機與教練機為主，噴射機數量有限，且多數在地面上被摧毀。支援裝備方面，聯合國軍以B-29在夜間襲擊北韓的工業、鐵路與飛彈基地，RF-84、F-86與F-80執行對地攻擊，P-51與F-51壓制地面目標，T-6與改裝夜間戰鬥機執行夜間攔截，地面有高射炮與機炮掩護空軍機場；蘇聯以供應線經綏芬河把MiG-15、發動機備件與武器送入東北，志願軍空軍的維修同樣靠鐵路與空運維持，這條線一旦斷掉，再好的戰機也飛不出米格走廊。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card, the F-86 Sabre, is the other principal actor of the air war. It went into production in 1949 with a swept wing and a nose full of guns: six M3 Browning .50-calibre machine guns with three hundred rounds in total, a J47 turbojet, a maximum level speed of roughly three hundred metres per second and a service ceiling around fifteen thousand metres. Its nose radar served search only; early gunnery relied on the pilot's eyes and a gunsight, and only later machines received radar sighting and a separated rear-seat camera. The opponent was the MiG-15, which also entered service in 1949: a thirty-five degree swept wing, six 37mm cannon and two 23mm cannon whose explosive effect far exceeded that of a .50 round, with better climb rate and ceiling but a turning radius just as heavy as the Sabre's. The MiG-15s of the Chinese Volunteer Air Force were mostly the improved variant fitted with an onboard radar able to search out to a dozen kilometres or more. The Korean People's Air Force relied on Soviet-transferred piston fighters and trainers, with only a limited number of jets, most of which were destroyed on the ground. On the support side, the United Nations used B-29s to strike North Korean industry, rail lines and missile sites at night, with RF-84s, F-86s and F-80s on attack missions, P-51s and F-51s against ground targets, and T-6s and modified night fighters on night interception, while antiaircraft and cannon defended the airfields. The Soviets moved MiG-15s, spares and ammunition into Manchuria over the Suifenhe route, and the volunteer air force depended on the same rail and air lift for maintenance; once that line broke, no aircraft of either kind could keep flying out of Mig Alley.
tactics: 空戰樣式在三年裡被逼出來。F-86起初中段沒有可用雷達，只能靠地面管制雷達網引導：朝鮮境內的雷達站把敵機位置送進空戰管制中心，指揮所再以無線電把「鎊鏈」四機編隊引到指定高度與航線，隊長機在前，後三機保持規定距離，編隊俗稱「桶」；志願軍空軍與蘇聯的米格常用大隊高空俯衝再以螺旋甩開，或者編隊分批上升、各機分頭射擊，利用數量與高度差迫使人類戰鬥機損失。F-86的弱點在低速轉向：機首重、操縱滯後，近距離纏鬥常被米格的爬升率壓住；米格雖同樣重，翼載與推重比在當時卻佔優。1951年後聯合國軍改為四波高度分層攔截，把米格引進有利高度再分割，同時以F-84與F-86做對地攻擊、F-51與F-80做近地支援。轟炸方面，B-29在白天有被米格攔截的風險，改以夜間編隊出動，配備搜索雷達與照明炸彈，與RB-26、RF-80混合編隊襲擊。志願軍空軍自1951年底起常以八至十二機編隊在六千至一萬公尺之間活動，採「打帶不打面」的方式消耗聯合國軍戰鬥機的可用架次，而不是爭取殲滅戰。
tacticsEn: The way this air war was fought was forced out of three years of fighting. Early F-86s had no usable radar of their own and depended entirely on a ground control network: radar stations inside Korea passed enemy contacts to the air control centre, and the controller talked the flight onto a designated altitude and track by radio, with the flight leader in front and the other three aircraft keeping a fixed interval, a formation the crews called the bucket. The Soviet and Chinese MiG-15s preferred to come down from high altitude in large formations, then break away with a hard turn, or to climb in waves and let each pair shoot separately, using numbers and height differences to force losses on the American fighters. The F-86's weakness was its turn at low speed: a heavy nose and slow controls meant that in a close turning engagement the MiG's climb rate usually won. The MiG-15 was just as heavy, but its wing loading and power-to-weight ratio were better for the day. After 1951 the United Nations switched to intercepting in four altitude-separated waves, drawing the MiGs into favourable height before splitting them, while F-84s and F-86s worked the ground and F-51s and F-80s provided close support. On the bombing side the B-29s, vulnerable to MiG interception in daylight, went out at night in formation with search radar and illumination bombs, mixed with RB-26s and RF-80s. From late 1951 the Volunteer Air Force habitually operated eight to twelve aircraft between six and ten thousand metres, wearing down the available sorties of United Nations fighters rather than trying to win a decisive engagement.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個時點。1950年11月1日，十一架F-86在北方與四十架以上的米格-15首次大規模接戰，聯合國軍宣稱擊落八架，其後按檔案只承認兩架確認、四架可能。12月6日，三架F-86在北方新安洲上空被擊落，飛行員一人陣亡、兩人被救回，其中一人由直升機營救。12月12日與12月21日，聯合國軍分別宣稱擊落八架與十架米格-15。全戰役F-86共損失三百三十九架，其中十八架屬敵方戰鬥損失，其餘多為起降與操作事故；美方官方戰果記錄列米格-15被擊落一千零一十六架，蘇聯與中國方面的宣稱合計則在三百架上下，蘇方記錄另有「擊落敵機一千零一十六架、其中F-86二百八十九架」的說法，與美方數字高度重疊，學界普遍認為雙方都含大量未經核實的部分。第39戰鬥攔截中隊宣稱的米格-15擊落數達二百四十五架。1951年4月14日，單日F-86出動一千零一十四架次，創下戰役中單日架次紀錄；1950年11月至1951年7月的B-29攻勢中，轟炸機共損失十二架。
dataEn: The checkable figures cluster around a handful of dates. On 1 November 1950 eleven F-86s met forty or more MiG-15s in the north in the first large engagement of the war; the United Nations claimed eight MiG-15s destroyed, and later archival review credited only two as confirmed and four as possible. On 6 December three F-86s were shot down over Sinchon in the north; one pilot was killed and two were recovered, one of them by helicopter. On 12 and 21 December the United Nations claimed eight and ten MiG-15s respectively. Across the whole war the F-86 lost 339 aircraft, of which eighteen were combat losses and the rest were mostly take-off, landing and handling accidents; the official American scorecard lists 1,016 MiG-15s shot down, while the combined claims of the Soviet and Chinese sides come to roughly three hundred, and Soviet records also contain the claim of 1,016 enemy aircraft destroyed including 289 F-86s, which overlaps the American figure closely; historians generally hold that both sides inflated heavily. The 39th Fighter-Interceptor Squadron claimed 245 MiG-15 kills. On 14 April 1951 F-86s flew 1,014 sorties in a single day, the highest sortie count of the war, and the B-29 offensive of November 1950 to July 1951 cost twelve bombers.
cause: 空戰之所以會變成整個半島的戰爭，源於1950年北韓越過三八線之後的連鎖反應。朝鮮人民軍在蘇聯軍事顧問指導下於六月二十五日發動攻擊，聯合國軍一路退到釜山；九月十五日仁川登陸在北韓後方插上一把刀，迫使北韓回頭，戰線推回三八線附近。十月裡聯合國軍策劃「統一」作戰，要攻擊平壤並把戰線推到鴨綠江，蘇聯與中國判斷這會變成另一場直接戰爭，於是志願軍在十月底渡江作戰，戰線被拉回清川江一線。空軍這邊的形勢在同時惡化：美軍決定把戰爭擴展到半島北部，轟炸目標從軍事物資擴到整座城市與通訊系統；志願軍空軍在1950年11月1日之後正式投入，第一天就出現大規模接戰。蘇聯不直接派兵入朝，卻以第64戰鬥航空兵與供應線支援北朝和中國空軍，等於把空戰變成兩個國家共同承擔的戰爭。
causeEn: The air war became a war for the whole peninsula because of the chain of reactions that followed North Korea's crossing of the thirty-eighth parallel in 1950. The Korean People's Army attacked on 25 June under Soviet military advisers, and the United Nations forces were driven all the way back to Pusan. The Incheon landing of 15 September put a knife into North Korea's rear, forcing it to turn around and pushing the front line back towards the thirty-eighth parallel. In October the United Nations planned the campaign to unify Korea, to strike Pyongyang and carry the front to the Yalu; the Soviets and the Chinese judged that this would become another direct war, so the Chinese volunteers crossed the river in late October and pulled the front back to the Ch'ongch'on line. The situation in the air deteriorated at the same time: the Americans extended the war into the north of the peninsula and widened the bombing from military supplies to whole cities and communications networks, while the Chinese volunteer air force formally entered the war after 1 November 1950 and met a large formation on its very first day. The Soviet Union never put its own troops into Korea, but it supported North Korea and the Chinese air effort through the 64th Fighter Aviation Corps and a supply line, which turned the air war into one carried jointly by two states.
impact: 這場空戰把冷戰推到第一線，也把噴射機時代的規則寫進了教科書。第一，空優只是條件，不是結論。1950年11月至12月，聯合國軍在天上有壓倒性優勢，地面卻仍在清川江與長津湖一線失利；決定戰線的是步兵、工兵與後勤，空軍能替地面部隊清理道路與掩體，卻不能代替地面部隊佔領山頭。第二，MiG-15的表現讓蘇聯看清自家截擊機的短處：雷達可靠而火控與座艙視野不足，近距離纏鬥並非蘇聯戰機的長項，這直接催生日後的Su-7與更完整的火控系統。第三，志願軍空軍以數量不多的噴射機維持了三個月的空中戰鬥，為中國空軍留下第一手的噴射機作戰經驗。第四，地面管制雷達與戰機引導的結合，成為此後數十年各國空軍的標準編制。第五，這場戰爭也留下一條政治教訓：以空戰勝利代替地面決策，最終只會把一場戰爭拉得更長。
impactEn: This air war pushed the Cold War to the front line and wrote the rules of the jet age into the textbooks. First, air superiority is a condition, not a conclusion. Between November and December 1950 the United Nations held a decisive advantage in the sky, yet on the ground the war was lost along the Ch'ongch'on and in the Chosin Reservoir area; what decided the front line was infantry, engineers and logistics. The air force could clear roads and shelter for the ground troops, but it could not take a ridge for them. Second, the performance of the MiG-15 showed the Soviets the weaknesses of their own interceptor: reliable radar but poor fire control and a cramped cockpit, and no talent for the close turning fight, defects that directly drove the later Su-7 and better fire control systems. Third, the Chinese Volunteer Air Force kept a small number of jets in the air battle for three months and gave the Chinese air force its first hands-on experience of jet combat. Fourth, the combination of ground control radar with fighter guidance became the standard organisation for air forces around the world for the decades that followed. Fifth, the war left a political lesson: substituting an air victory for a ground decision only makes the war longer.
result: 結果並不乾淨。停戰協定在1953年7月27日簽署，交戰線大致回到三八線，雙方各自退到一線之隔的附近；聯合國軍在整個戰役期間保住制空權，最後兩年米格-15雖然在數量與口徑上佔優，仍未能扭轉局勢。空戰本身的勝負帳很難算清：美方宣稱擊落米格-15一千零一十六架，蘇聯與中國的宣稱加起來不到一半；聯合國軍的F-86損失三百三十九架，其中十八架屬敵方戰鬥損失。真正確定的結果是：北韓空軍作為一支成建制力量在1950年底之後就退出戰鬥，制空權長期掌握在聯合國軍手裡，讓志願軍與北韓在地面上付出遠高於空中的代價；蘇聯與中國的米格-15無法在制空權上取回主導，只能在夜間與邊境地帶打游擊式的交鋒。空戰的勝負最終沒有變成朝鮮的統一，也沒有讓任何一方達成政治目標，兩條戰線在1953年7月各自停了下來。
resultEn: The result is not clean. The armistice agreement was signed on 27 July 1953, and the line of contact returned roughly to the thirty-eighth parallel, each side falling back to within a short distance of it. The United Nations held air superiority for the whole war, and although the MiG-15 outnumbered the Sabre and out-gunned it in the last two years, it never turned the situation. The score in the air itself is hard to settle: the Americans claimed 1,016 MiG-15s shot down, while the Soviet and Chinese claims together come to less than half of that; the United Nations lost 339 F-86s, of which eighteen were combat losses. What is certain is this: as an organised force the North Korean air force ceased to be a factor after the end of 1950, and control of the air stayed with the United Nations for the rest of the war, which meant the Chinese volunteers and North Korea paid on the ground a price far higher than the one they paid in the sky. The MiG-15s flown by Soviet and Chinese pilots could not win back air superiority and could only trade opportunistic blows at night and along the fringes. The air war did not decide the unification of Korea, nor did it deliver the political aims of any side; on 27 July 1953 both lines simply stopped.
